pubs.ssci-2026-01: Paid OTT like Netflix versus ad-supported free streaming — how do viewers split between them? This study examines how conversations on social media influence the use of free and paid video streaming services.
pubs.ssci-2026-02: On luxury resale platforms, a high price can attract buyers at one moment and repel them at another. This study identifies the conditions under which price premiums drive or deter demand.
pubs.ssci-2026-03: Do we open apps more on rainy days? This study uses data to analyze how the spaces people occupy and daily weather conditions shape mobile app engagement.
pubs.ssci-2026-04: The same push notification lands differently when it feels personal. This field experiment tests whether personalized push notifications actually increase user engagement.
pubs.ssci-2026-05: Do we use an app more when its notifications speak with human-like emotion? This study examines how the effect of emotionally anthropomorphized notifications varies with usage frequency.
pubs.ssci-2025-01: Do we spend more when playing games alongside strangers? Using real online game data, this study shows that even anonymous strangers influence our spending.
pubs.ssci-2025-02: Click → sign up → purchase. This study shows consumers respond differently to real-time mobile offers at each stage of the decision journey, with implications for when to send which offer.
pubs.ssci-2025-03: Does a bigger brand logo help promotion, or suppress sharing? This empirical study analyzes how logo size in social media posts affects content virality.
pubs.ssci-2025-04: In immersive technologies like VR and AR, is being a foreign firm an asset or a liability? This study analyzes the liability of foreignness in extended reality innovation from an international business perspective.
pubs.ssci-2024-01: "Your card was charged" — even routine payment alerts can change how we spend. This study reveals the surprising consequences of innocuous mobile transaction reminders on consumer spending.
pubs.ssci-2024-02: Does a nearby physical store lift online sales? This study shows the effect of offline store presence on digital sales depends on product functionality.
pubs.ssci-2024-03: How do older adults choose healthcare providers? This study examines what older consumers' choices mean amid local competition in healthcare services — a question central to aging societies.
pubs.ssci-2023-01: How much does the fear of data leaks hold back technology use? This meta-analysis synthesizes a large body of prior research on privacy concern and information technology.
pubs.ssci-2023-02: Tastes are not fixed — they keep shifting. This study designs a recommendation system that reflects dynamic preferences and applies it to the mobile game industry.
pubs.ssci-2022-01: Does a handwritten note in the delivery box actually work? This field experiment tests how handwritten notes from online retailers affect customer response.
pubs.ssci-2022-02: The emotion in a video's thumbnail and title can change the fate of the ad that precedes it. This study analyzes how pre-roll advertising effectiveness varies with the emotional tone of content.
pubs.ssci-2022-03: Does more time on Instagram lead to more time in shopping apps? This study traces the link from social media app usage to shopping app usage on smartphones.
pubs.ssci-2022-04: Bad news spreads faster and louder. Analyzing microblog and news data, this study documents sentiment change and negative herding in public opinion.
pubs.ssci-2022-05: What happens to incumbents when everyday medicines can be sold outside pharmacies? This study analyzes incumbent firms' performance and responses to OTC drug market deregulation.
pubs.ssci-2021-01: Does living digitally make us happier? Focusing on Asian consumers, this study examines the moderating roles of digital-native status and privacy concern in digital well-being.
pubs.ssci-2021-02: When buying electronics, do we stick with the channel we used before? Comparing consumer data from China and South Korea, this study analyzes channel stickiness in the shopping journey.
pubs.ssci-2021-03: How do SMEs find trading partners in online B2B marketplaces? This study empirically analyzes buyer–supplier matching among small and medium-sized enterprises.
pubs.ssci-2021-04: Who are the shoppers who move between stores and online? Using French apparel industry data, this study profiles multichannel shoppers and how retailers can use them.
pubs.ssci-2020-01: Buy now, enjoy later — products like concert tickets are shaped by both online and offline environments. This study analyzes how the two drive online social interactions and sales.
pubs.ssci-2020-02: There is a reason online-first brands open physical stores. This 'clicks to bricks' study analyzes what happens when digital retailers launch products in offline stores.
pubs.ssci-2020-03: Do usage-restriction rules like game 'shutdown laws' actually work? This study evaluates the real consequences of such laws on online game usage and spending, adding evidence to the policy debate.
pubs.ssci-2019-01: Do earlier reviews sway the next person's rating? Analyzing TripAdvisor review data, this study examines how eWOM characteristics affect consumer ratings.
pubs.ssci-2019-02: Can a celebrity endorser lift firm value itself? This study analyzes the effect of celebrity endorsement on sustainable firm value in the Korean telecommunications industry.
pubs.ssci-2019-03: Do neighborhoods with more social contact shop differently online? This study analyzes how the degree of offline social interactions affects online shopping demand.
pubs.ssci-2019-04: What do consumers look at when buying feature-augmented products? This study examines the role of design innovation in understanding purchase behavior for augmented products.
pubs.ssci-2017-01: What brings customers back — money (discounts and rewards) or people (social influence)? This study compares how social interactions and monetary incentives drive consumer repeat behavior.
pubs.ssci-2017-02: Installing a shopping app does not mean buying. This study separates app possession from mobile purchase to understand the structure of mobile shopping behavior.
pubs.ssci-2017-03: The performance of online niche products is tied to offline brand conditions. This study links online niche sales to the state of brands offline.
pubs.ssci-2012-01: How are new customers acquired on the internet? Comparing traditional and IS-enabled acquisition, this study laid groundwork for online customer acquisition strategy.
pubs.ssci-2012-02: What matters most in internet retailing? This study distills the key drivers of online retail success for practicing managers.
pubs.ssci-2011-01: When your tastes make you a local minority, the internet matters more. This study shows that 'preference minorities' — those underserved offline — rely more on online shopping.
pubs.ssci-2010-01: Even online grocery shopping starts by following the neighbors. This study analyzes the spatiotemporal pattern of imitation among new buyers at an online grocery retailer.
pubs.kci-2026-01: Does an influencer's word really convert to purchases? This study analyzes how the effect of influencer communication on purchase conversion varies with product type and regional characteristics.
pubs.kci-2026-02: When convenience stores and franchise supermarkets compete in the same trade area, do private-brand (PB) products sell more? This study analyzes how channel competition affects PB sales performance.
pubs.kci-2026-03: When a franchise headquarters hits a crisis, what happens to its portfolio of brands? This study analyzes the ripple effects of headquarters crises on portfolio performance.
pubs.kci-2025-01: What makes people first install a food delivery app? This study analyzes the role of social influence — the usage of people around us — in food delivery app adoption.
pubs.kci-2025-02: Why do luxury brands open stores in the metaverse? This study examines how marketing in virtual spaces drives consumer brand engagement for luxury fashion brands.
pubs.kci-2024-01: For virtual influencers, what kind of face works? This study analyzes how the facial characteristics of virtual influencers affect social media user responses.
pubs.kci-2024-02: During the pandemic, which neighborhoods lost more gyms? This study shows that risk exposure and compensatory spending had distinct effects on regional gym closures.
pubs.kci-2023-01: Is fandom driven by wins or by communication? This study analyzes how a club's match performance and social media operations affect fan engagement, and how fan tokens moderate the relationship.
pubs.kci-2023-02: Is being physically close to other firms really an advantage? Using machine learning, this study unveils the role of industrial similarity and revisits assumptions about proximity.
pubs.kci-2023-03: What makes us trust an unfamiliar food product online? This study analyzes how trust-building product strategies translate into word of mouth on online food platforms.
pubs.kci-2023-04: What makes someone who tried a chatbot keep using it? This study analyzes the determinants of continuance intention for chatbot services.
pubs.kci-2023-05: Can a single new app shake an entire market? This study analyzes how a new app launch reshapes the existing app ecosystem in digital healthcare.
pubs.kci-2023-06: What drives the finger that hits 'skip ad'? This study analyzes how video genre, viewers' digital-native traits, and media attributes affect pre-roll ad avoidance.
pubs.kci-2022-01: How should branded content appear in short-form video to work? This study shows that perceived belongingness mediates the path from short-form branded content exposure to consumer response.
pubs.kci-2022-02: When a webtoon becomes a drama, how much do news articles help? This study analyzes the effect of news publicity on viewers' online word of mouth for webtoon-based dramas.
pubs.kci-2022-03: When lockdowns lift, do people immediately socialize again? Using a Bayesian multilevel difference-in-differences approach, this study precisely measures the effect of lockdown repeal on socialization.
pubs.kci-2022-04: Does easier payment mean more shopping? Using the cases of KakaoPay and Kakao Gift, this study analyzes how adopting simple payment affects shopping app usage.
pubs.kci-2022-05: What should moderators do to keep a community alive? Analyzing university 'Bamboo Forest' communities, this study derives management strategies that boost user participation.
pubs.kci-2022-06: Does the same ad perform differently on PC and mobile? This study compares the effectiveness of food ad targeting on video platforms across devices.
pubs.kci-2022-07: Who considered leaving their job during the pandemic? This study analyzes the determinants of online job search behavior during COVID-19.
pubs.kci-2021-01: Does social media buzz translate into actual usage? Using time-series data on Seoul's bike-sharing service, this study analyzes the relationship between social media and consumer purchase decisions.
pubs.kci-2021-02: In the era of remote work and distancing, what determined job satisfaction? This study analyzes the determinants of job satisfaction and mobile productivity during COVID-19.
pubs.kci-2020-01: How did a small craft brewery break into the market? Through the case of Amazing Brewing Company, this study analyzes the startup strategy of craft breweries.
pubs.kci-2020-02: Is a health food's name half the battle? This study analyzes how product naming, customer product experience, and firm promotions each affect health food purchases.
pubs.kci-2020-03: Where do we shop on hot, humid days? This study analyzes how weather discomfort and shopping preferences shape retail store choice.
pubs.kci-2018-01: The same luxury item performs differently depending on where it is sold. This study shows the effects of product, customer, and assortment on luxury sales vary by store type.
pubs.kci-2016-01: The words firms write and consumers leave online hold clues to sales. This study analyzes online text data to derive strategies for growing online revenue.
pubs.kci-2016-02: Does marketing work in B2B too? This study analyzes how B2B firms' marketing activities and their customers' market environments affect sales performance.
pubs.kci-2015-01: When local stores disappear, do niche products sell more online? This study analyzes how changes in the offline environment affect online demand for niche products.
pubs.kci-2015-02: What makes people pay for video on their phones? This empirical study verifies the factors driving mobile VOD content purchases.
pubs.kci-2014-01: How far has social media research come? This review maps the trends and gaps in social media research across the social sciences.
pubs.kci-2014-02: How big can a shopping mall grow while depending on portals? This study analyzes how resource dependence on internet portals affects the growth of online shopping mall firms.
pubs.kci-2013-01: What sets apart platforms where creators are active? This study shows producer participation on user-generated content platforms has distinct effects on consumer choice and engagement.
pubs.kci-2026-04: Do sneakers made with recycled materials fetch a premium on the resale market? Using the case of Asics, this study analyzes how price premiums form for eco-material products.
pubs.kci-2023-07: When workplace stress builds up, are smartphone apps a remedy or a burden? This study analyzes the moderating role of mobile app use between workplace stressors and positive affect.
pubs.kci-2016-03: How do teenagers themselves see game regulation? Focusing on the targets' reactance and peer culture, this study examines online game regulation from the youths' perspective.
pubs.kci-2016-04: Even the same brand performs differently online and offline by region. This study analyzes how regional specificity creates differences in offline and online channel performance.
pubs.kci-2016-05: What sets high-performing stores apart? This study analyzes how in-store and surrounding environments, along with local market conditions, affect store performance.
pubs.kci-2016-06: In-game currency versus real cash — when do players spend which? This empirical study analyzes game money and cash money consumption through experience, achievement, and regional disparity.
pubs.kci-2015-03: Does moving to a new region change the brands we buy online? This study analyzes how consumers' regional migration affects changes in online brand preference.
pubs.kci-2015-04: New and existing products perform differently depending on the channel. Analyzing time-series data on experience goods, this study examines sales performance across offline and online channels.
pubs.kci-2014-03: The reasons players leave differ between new and long-time users. This study analyzes the churn drivers of online game customers by customer type.
